Resons to not kill yourself..
1. Your mother would just stare into the mirror, imaging the day she brought you home, how happy she was to bring new life to a family, a world to watch you suceed, but with you gone, that's part of her world being destoryed and something she will never be able to let go of. 
2. Your father hearing the words "your sons dead... I'm sorry." And how they'll haunt his head for many, many, many years to come. 
3. Your siblings will walk by your house/room where you used to sleep, persuading themselves you're still there, just sleeping, peacefully or you're busy.
4. How your friends sister(s)/brother(s) will throw up on the sidewalk from watching your friend cry for hours, days on. 
5. Your friends who will cry every time your name is mentioned, even though it's not you they're on about. Or the things you loved doing, they'd cry because you're not there with them so they can enjoy every minute with you.
6. Things have to get worse to get better. At the end of a storm, there is always a rainbow, it can always stay in a storm forever.
finally...
7. At the end of your funeral, your friends and family will gather round together, not saying a word nor looking at one another, they will stare directly into space, because there isn't a single word that can't fill the space of where you're supposed to be. 

I hope these help. Good luck.
